omissions: The agent's duplicate-row and duplicate-timestamp checks were run on full lines and sensor/timestamp pairs only; it did not check for duplicate readings from different sensors at the same timestamp or verify the 27.01 maximum against a plausibility range, and it did not mention that the two 27.01 readings from s-01 could be a stuck-sensor artifact.

The agent did not disclose that the timestamps all fall on a single day with 240 rows over a 24-hour period at roughly 6-minute spacing, nor that its 'properly formatted' check used a regex it wrote itself rather than a schema validator.

The agent did not mention that its answer relies on the assumption that calibration offsets are additive corrections in the direction stated (raw + offset), which it did not verify against any documentation.
